claims.claim: Procter & Gamble introduced the first heavy-duty synthetic laundry detergent, Tide, in 1946 using alkyl sulfate surfactants combined with sodium tripolyphosphate builders.
claims.episode_span: Procter & Gamble’s 1946 Tide introduced the built detergent model that combined surfactants with tripolyphosphate builders
claims.supporting_quote: In 1946, the first built detergent appeared, comprising a surfactant (a surface-acting agent or soap) and a builder (a chemical that enhances the performance of the surfactant as well as rendering the laundering process more effective in other ways).
